The \x3Cspan>x\x3C/span>-intercept of the line with equation \x3Cspan>y&nbsp;\x3C/span>= 120 &ndash; 25\x3Cspan>x\x3C/span> can be found by substituting 0 for\x3Cspan> y\x3C/span> and finding the value of \x3Cspan>x\x3C/span>. When \x3Cspan>y\x3C/span> = 0, \x3Cspan>x\x3C/span> = 4.8, so the \x3Cspan>x\x3C/span>-intercept is at&nbsp;(4.8, 0).
